newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket falls for 5th week running.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket falls for 5th week running.

text.p: The average price of Venezuela's basket of crude oil and refined products fell for a fifth consecutive week to $17.27 per barrel, 93 cents below last Friday, the Energy and Mines Ministry said in a statement.
The weekly figures showed February's average price stood at $18.88 per barrel against $21.53 per barrel for January.
For the year so far, the basket stood at $20.27 per barrel, versus $20.64 last week.
Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said on Thursday that he did not expect the average price for 1997 to fall below $15.50 per barrel.
"Although the (worldwide) volume (of production) is greater than demand, the market has in some way absorbed it because there are niches and spaces," he said.
The Venezuelan budget planned on an average basket price of $14.00 for 1997.
